# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"The UI must validate Coil Height input for Water/Steam coils, enforcing a valid range of 1.25\" to 100\" and requiring the entered height to be a multiple of a coil‑specific increment; if the input is not an exact multiple, it must be rounded to the nearest valid increment based on the coil type or configuration."

## Reviewer Findings

- F1 | MEDIUM | UNSUPPORTED_ASSUMPTION | "The interpreter assumes the system should display the rounded value to the user after validation, but the ticket does not specify any UI display behavior." | "Remove the assumption or obtain clarification from the ticket owner whether the rounded value must be shown to the user."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The ticket does not specify how to resolve ties when the entered value is exactly halfway between two valid increments (e.g., rounding up vs. down)." | "Obtain clarification on the tie‑break policy for rounding (e.g., round up, round down, or round to even)."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The required behavior for inputs below 1.25\" or above 100\" is not defined (error, clamp, or other handling)." | "Clarify the expected handling for out‑of‑range values (e.g., display an error message, clamp to limits, reject input)."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The method for indicating \"3/8\\\" tube with 1\\\" spacing\" in the UI (separate spacing field, combined selection, etc.) is not described." | "Provide UI design details on how the spacing configuration is captured and associated with the tube size."
- F5 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "No guidance is provided for coil types or configurations not listed in the increment table." | "Clarify how the system should handle coil types or configurations that are not explicitly listed (e.g., reject, default increment, or extend the table)."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "The ticket does not specify how to resolve ties when the entered value is exactly halfway between two valid increments (e.g., rounding up vs. down)."
- /ambiguities/1 | "The required behavior for inputs below 1.25\" or above 100\" is not defined (error, clamp, or other handling)."
- /ambiguities/2 | "The method for indicating \"3/8\\\" tube with 1\\\" spacing\" in the UI (separate spacing field, combined selection, etc.) is not described."
- /ambiguities/3 | "No guidance is provided for coil types or configurations not listed in the increment table."

## Final Disposition

FAIL

## Governance Reasons

- OPEN_FINDINGS
- OPEN_AMBIGUITIES
